thread.title: Apple shares hit new all-time intraday and closing highs

author: MacDailyNews
title: Apple shares hit new all-time intraday and closing highs
text:
Apple shares hit new all-time intraday and closing highs Friday, January 12, 2018 · 4:31 pm · 4 Comments In Nasdaq trading today, shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) rose $1.81, or 1.03%, to hit a new all-time closing high of $177.09. Apple’s previous all-time closing high was $176.42 set on December 18, 2017.
AAPL’s all-time intraday high stands at $177.35, also set today. 
Apple’s 52-week low stands at $118.22. 
Apple, the world’s most valuable company, currently has a market value of $900.867 billion.
